behaviour: NotificationsTable accepts highlightedNotificationId and marks the matching row as current and highlighted.
rules: 1. The new optional prop is highlightedNotificationId?: string with the TSDoc line: Id of a notification to highlight, for example one opened through a deep link.

2. In the compact-data column, the outer Flex of a row whose notification.id equals highlightedNotificationId gets className={styles.highlighted} and aria-current="true"; other rows get neither attribute (pass undefined).
3. highlightedNotificationId joins the compactColumns useMemo dependency list.

behaviour: The notifications page reads ?id=, pins a deep-linked notification missing from the current page at the top, and highlights it.
rules: 1. const [searchParams] = useSearchParams(); const highlightedId = searchParams.get('id') ?? undefined; both placed after the existing useNotificationsApi call and before the first early return.
2. const pageNotifications = value?.[0]?.notifications; const missingFromPage = !!highlightedId && !!pageNotifications && !pageNotifications.some(n => n.id === highlightedId);

3. const { value: pinnedNotification } = useNotificationsApi<Notification | undefined>(api => missingFromPage && highlightedId ? api.getNotification(highlightedId).catch(() => undefined) : Promise.resolve(undefined), [highlightedId, missingFromPage]);
4. The notifications passed to the table are [pinnedNotification, ...(pageNotifications ?? [])] when missingFromPage and pinnedNotification are both set, otherwise pageNotifications.
5. NotificationsTable receives highlightedNotificationId={highlightedId}; filters, paging, title and totalCount stay as they are; without ?id the page behaves exactly as before.
